title: Let Naam answer the ache of incompletion
summary: The shabad answers lack by placing Naam in the heart — the path, cleansing, and honor become whole under the Perfect One's shelter.
takeaway: Let Naam answer the ache of incompletion.
lifeApplication: When comparison starts listing what is missing, return to one remembered Name before you reach for another measure.

source.shortMeaning: Path, cleansing, and honor are made whole when Naam is held in the heart.
source.lifeApplication: Meet the feeling of lack by returning to Naam before measuring yourself again.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad locates wholeness in Naam held in the heart, not in another outward proof.
evidence.turn: Comparison loses force when incompletion is answered by the Perfect One's shelter.
evidence.practicalImplication: When comparison starts listing what is missing, return to one remembered Name before you reach for another measure.
